requiredBehaviors.behavior: identify the assets as an inconsistent brand family
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The skill requires logo, favicon and app icon to form one coherent recognizable brand family.
Existing mismatched branding assets must be documented as a conflict before writing the final design context.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: clarify which existing asset is the leading brand source before deriving the others
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The error-handling rule explicitly requires identifying the leading brand source before deriving the remaining assets.

forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The conflict must be surfaced and resolved rather than silently preserved.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: invent a fourth unrelated visual direction
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The skill explicitly forbids silently inventing another visual direction when existing brand assets conflict.
